title: Multiscale Aggregated Hierarchical Attention (MAHA): A Constrained and Consensus-Based Approach to Efficient Contextual Modeling in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2512.14925v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The quadratic computational complexity of Multi-Head Self-Attention (MHSA) remains a fundamental bottleneck in scaling Large Language Models (LLMs) for long-context tasks. While sparse and linearized attention mechanisms attempt to mitigate this, they often compromise the representation of global dependencies or fail to capture multiscale semantic granularity effectively. In this paper, we propose Multiscale Aggregated Hierarchical Attention (MAHA), a novel architectural framework that reformulates the attention mechanism through hierarchical decomposition and explicitly constrained aggregation. Unlike conventional approaches that treat token interactions at a single resolution, MAHA dynamically partitions the input sequence into hierarchical scales via learnable downsampling operators. translated_title: 多尺度聚合层次注意力（MAHA）：一种基于约束与共识的大语言模型高效上下文建模方法
translated_abstract: 多头自注意力（MHSA）的二次方计算复杂度仍然是大语言模型（LLM）在长上下文任务扩展中的根本瓶颈。虽然稀疏注意力和线性化注意力机制试图缓解这一问题，但它们往往损害了全局依赖关系的表示能力，或无法有效捕捉多尺度的语义粒度。在本文中，我们提出了多尺度聚合层次注意力，这是一种新颖的架构框架，通过层次化分解和显式约束聚合来重新构建注意力机制。与在单一分辨率下处理词元交互的传统方法不同，MAHA通过可学习的下采样算子将输入序列动态划分为层次化的尺度。对齐后的各尺度输出则通过概率单纯形上的softmax归一化权重，或固定数量的可微分共识……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出多尺度聚合层次注意力（MAHA）框架，通过层次化分解与显式约束聚合重构注意力机制，以突破多头自注意力的二次复杂度瓶颈，实现大语言模型高效的多尺度长上下文建模。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Multiscale Aggregated Hierarchical Attention (MAHA), a novel framework that reformulates attention via hierarchical decomposition and explicitly constrained aggregation to overcome the quadratic complexity of MHSA, enabling efficient multiscale long-context modeling in large language models.
